style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

aestheticGoals.outcome: A coherent crafted conveyor with softened, readable rail and deck volume, a stable supported structure, and deliberate proportions. Native modeling improvements may replace the source's awkward slabs, topology and part count.
visibleChecks: Coral rails have a controlled warm shoulder/edge response and readable depth rather than a flat fill with an abrupt muddy underside band.
The slate deck reads as evenly spaced moving slats with softly expressed shoulders and troughs; its broad surface stays orderly in every frame and facing.

Supports and underside communicate a purposeful load-bearing structure, remain separable from the deck, and avoid accidental merged forms. No exact support count or blank-plane preservation is required.
The exact approved family connection section and materials remain continuous at joins. Useful interior design can improve without bulging, capping, masking or overhanging a join.

aestheticGoals.outcome: Warm peach/coral rails, cooler blue/slate deck and honey wood form a clear family palette. Material distinction and restrained construction details visibly improve on the original.
visibleChecks: Use the approved native common material vocabulary exactly at compatible surfaces. No per-facing recolor or inconsistent exposure.
Wood reads warm and softly modeled instead of near-black; restrained grain, bevels or fasteners may add craft where readable. Purposeful decoration is welcome but no fixed bolt count is required.
Small accents support the construction and simplify cleanly at phone size; no glitter, noise, arbitrary ornament or harsh metallic streaks.

Do not copy target halos, faint stray alpha, gold overhanging end collars or altered framing. A material difference from the ImageGen target is acceptable when needed to meet the approved native family contract.

aestheticGoals.outcome: Soft warm cartoon shading stays clear, artifact-free and coherent under all four rotations, all animation samples and intended game sizes.
visibleChecks: Broad controlled highlights reveal form without blown white bands, waxy glare, black patches, muddy intersections or abrupt normal changes.
No preferred horizontal light direction, no directional ground shadow, no per-facing fitting, recoloring or raster seam repair.
At128,55,32 logical pixels per cell, rails, moving deck and supports remain recognizable on light, gray and dark backgrounds; no support dead spots or merged deck/rail edge.
Inspect every actual native frame and four motion previews for flicker, phase jumps, texture swimming, clipping, missing surfaces, broken corners, exposed end artifacts, or looping discontinuity.
A clean view cannot compensate for a dead spot in another view. The single target view does not demand invented unseen details.
